services.title: Make AI coding actually deliver
services.subtitle: Hands-on services for teams adopting AI coding: turn AI-assisted development into real productivity, then turn AI-generated code into a trustworthy asset. Every engagement starts with a written diagnosis — verify first, invest after.
services.aDesc: Assess how your team actually uses Cursor, Claude Code and agent workflows, surface the efficiency leaks and risks, and deliver an actionable optimization plan.
services.aPrice: Diagnostic report from $500–2,000, depending on team size
services.bDesc: Audit the AI/agent-generated parts of your codebase, deliver a prioritized risk report, and remediate on request. Especially relevant for teams facing disclosure obligations (e.g. CRA vulnerability reporting duties).
services.bPrice: Audit report from $3K, depending on codebase size
services.why1Body: Every position on AI coding and agent security comes from direct hands-on work, documented bilingually on hao430.cn (including “Your AI Agent Is Running as Root”).
services.why2Body: References are independently verified (JetBrains, Stack Overflow, industry incidents); unverifiable numbers are not repeated, and hype is not recycled.
services.why3Body: A free 30-minute diagnosis comes first; the written proposal and fixed quote follow. No hidden fees, no lock-in.
services.process1Body: Online call to understand your situation, goals and pain points. You decide whether to continue.
services.process2Body: A written proposal with a fixed quote within 48 hours of the diagnosis. No later upsells.
services.process3Body: Deliverables are produced milestone by milestone, verifiable at each step.
services.ctaBody: One conversation gets you the biggest AI-coding waste and the most urgent risks in your team. Replies usually within 24 hours.
services.fineprint: Diagnosis is free, no sales pitch, no lock-in. Transparent pricing: audit from $3K, workflow diagnosis $500–2,000, remediation from $20K.
services.aPoints1: Team AI-coding capability audit (where you are vs. what's achievable)
services.aPoints2: Workflow and engineering standards design (prompt assets, review loops, agent boundaries)
services.aPoints3: Rollout support: a staged path from pilot team to org-wide adoption
services.bPoints1: AI-code footprint detection and risk-surface scanning (supply chain, permissions, leaked secrets)
services.bPoints2: Written risk report: itemized severity ratings + fix guidance, ready for compliance workflows
services.bPoints3: Optional remediation delivery: from $20K, scoped per engagement, quoted up front
